checks.summary: No code analysis adapter is implemented.
Every declared endpoint answers over verified TLS.
No media analysis adapter is implemented.
Registered metadata matches its hash and the v1 schema.
The registered signer account exists and its key can authorize.
The signer account is too new to assess its history.
No threat-intelligence feed is integrated; serious wallet-risk flags are never set.
No token analysis adapter is implemented.

limitations: Limited assessment: metadata integrity, endpoint TLS and reachability, and signer account state only.
Code, media, token and threat-feed checks are unsupported and are not passes.
A passing assessment does not establish that the agent behaves safely or will in future.
The evidence hash commits to this report; it is not a privacy or zero-knowledge proof.
scoring: Each implemented check scores 0 when passed and 100 when failed. The risk score is the integer ceiling of the mean of scored checks. Inconclusive, not-applicable and unsupported checks are unscored.
